data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2001 closed 2015 with gross outstanding claims of GBP 1,657.7m at 1 January 2015 and recorded a net release of prior year reserves driven by favourable development and a benign catastrophe year. The claims movements show a gross prior-year release of GBP 53.5m (net release reported as GBP 38.3m), largely attributable to favourable development on prior catastrophe and special risk accounts and the absence of large catastrophe activity in 2015. Reinsurance-related classes (Catastrophe North America and Special Risk) are noted as primary contributors to the prior period releases.
raw_causal_phrases: releases from reserves established in prior years of GBP 38.3 million (2014: GBP 8.2 million)
absence of a large catastrophe loss experience during the year
increased prior period reserve releases predominantly driven by releases on Catastrophe North America and Special Risk classes
benign year in terms of catastrophe activity
a lower volume of larger losses and increased prior period reserve releases
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) taken from note 9(a) 'Movements arising from prior year claims' insurance liabilities column (gross) = (53.5). The report also states a NET prior year release of GBP 38.3m in the narrative; gross and net differ due to reinsurer's share. No explicit gross PYD split by LOB provided, so LOB-level amounts are not quantified. Claims development triangle contains an aggregate '2010 and prior' column which was excluded per instructions.
